intro: Twenty short tasks, about ten minutes. There's no pass or fail: the check only shows where to start and what to support. Answers are not marked during the check — just do your best and skip nothing.

parts.title: Грамматика
parts.intro: Выбери вариант, который подходит лучше всего. Задания идут от простых к сложным — если не знаешь, выбирай наугад.

exercise.prompt: We ___ to the cinema last night.
This room is ___ than the kitchen.
I ___ this film three times already.
I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
Look at those clouds. It ___ rain.
If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
You ___ wear a uniform here. It's the rule.
If I ___ more time, I would learn Japanese.

parts.title: Чтение
parts.intro: Прочитай объявление и ответь на три вопроса.

exercise.title: Language Exchange Evenings
exercise.text:
Do you want to practise a language with real people? Join our Language Exchange Evenings!
We meet every Thursday from 6 to 8 p.m. in the café on the ground floor of the New Building.
You spend one hour speaking your language and one hour speaking the language you are learning.
It's free for students, but please register at the International Office by Wednesday. Places are limited to thirty people.

questions.prompt: When do the evenings take place?
How long do you speak the language you are learning?
What do students need to do first?

parts.title: Аудирование
parts.intro: Послушай объявление и ответь на три вопроса. Текста на экране не будет, но послушать можно несколько раз.

exercise.speaker: announcer
exercise.audio: Good morning, everyone. This is a message from the International Office. Because of repairs, the library in the Old Building is closed until Friday. Students can use the study room on the second floor of the New Building instead. It's open from eight in the morning until ten at night. If you have borrowed books, please return them next Monday. Thank you.

options: On the second floor of the New Building
questions.answer: On the second floor of the New Building

parts.title: Письмо
parts.intro: Напиши предложение по-английски. Маленькие ошибки в написании не страшны.

exercise.ru: Она не пьёт кофе по утрам.
answers: She doesn't drink coffee in the morning
She does not drink coffee in the morning
She doesn't drink coffee in the mornings
She does not drink coffee in the mornings
Do they live near the station?

exercise.ru: Я ещё не закончил домашнее задание.
answers: I haven't finished my homework yet
I have not finished my homework yet
I haven't finished the homework yet
I have not finished the homework yet
I haven't done my homework yet
I have not done my homework yet
